answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 32095 Country: India Title: IN NIKAH NAMA INSTEAD OF REAL,NATURAL AND BIOLOGICAL FATHER SOME OTHER RELATIVE GETS HIS NAME RECORDED WHAT WOULD BE SHARAHIAN NATURE OF SUCH MARRIAG Question: If a girl whose real and natural mother and father have died and that orphan girl`s marriage in the columns of father and walee instead of the name of her real and biological or natural father ,some other relative gets his name recorded as both father and walee whether such marriage is void and sin? Answer ID: 32095 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 891/565/L=1432) If the witnesses are aware of it and they know the girl, nikah shall be valid by replacing the name of father with the name of the person who has adopted her in Nikah papers. However, it is not right to write the name of other person in place of her real father. Instead of the name of any other person, the name of her real father should be written in Nikah papers: قلت وظاهره انها لو جرت المقدمات على معينة وتميزت عند الشهود ايضا يصح العقد وهو واقعة الفتوى لأن المقصود نفى الجهالة وذالك حاصل بتعينها عند العاقدين والشهود (شامى). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
